name: Rafiul Hasan
bio: Met during first year at BUET. We used to pull all-nighters before exams together. Now he's working at a startup in Dhaka.

name: Nadia Sultana
bio: Known each other since Class 4. She moved to Chittagong but we still catch up every week over a call.

name: Aryan Kapoor
bio: Worked together at the same company for 2 years. He taught me most of what I know about backend development. Now freelancing.

name: Tasnia Akter

name: James McCarthy
bio: Met through an online coding challenge in 2022. We both love strategy games and often collaborate on side projects.

name: Mehzabin Chowdhury
bio: Grew up on the same street. We have coffee together every other week. She's the person I call when I need honest advice.

name: Tanvir Ahmed
bio: Best friends through college. We've drifted a bit since he moved to Canada for his masters but I want to keep that connection alive.

name: Sofia Reyes
bio: My first manager at my internship. She believed in me when I doubted myself. Now I reach out regularly for career advice.

name: Imran Hossain
bio: Grew up together at our grandparents' house every summer. We used to fish at the pond behind the village. Haven't talked properly in a while.

name: Priya Sharma
bio: Met at a local book club meetup two years ago. We share the same taste in fiction and often exchange recommendations over text.

name: Lucas Fernandez
bio: We built a project together at a 36-hour hackathon and ended up winning third place. Still brainstorm ideas together whenever we can.

name: Ruksana Begum
bio: My closest friend from school. We went through a lot together — exams, heartbreaks, family troubles. She always picks up no matter when I call.
